violation_type.short_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual
violation_type.typical_finding: Two caregivers were observed administering prohibited punishment. One caregiver was observed pulling a child by the arm from underneath a table and another caregiver was observed grabbing a child by the arm and holding onto the child to keep the child from moving out of a chair. The same caregiver was observed grabbing on a child and pulling on the child's arms.

finding_variants.text: Two caregivers were observed administering prohibited punishment. One caregiver was observed pulling a child by the arm from underneath a table and another caregiver was observed grabbing a child by the arm and holding onto the child to keep the child from moving out of a chair. The same caregiver was observed grabbing on a child and pulling on the child's arms.
It was determined that a caregiver pinched a child's neck and ears as well as  forcefully made them pick up toys.
A caregiver used yelling and physical punishment as discipline methods.
A caregiver used inappropriate discipline with a child in care.
Based on the information obtained, a deficiency for inappropriate discipline will be cited.
It was determined that a caregiver duct tapped children's shoes, to prevent them from taking off their shoes.
